thread:
elaine (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR for the post-incident docs errata after last night's outage. Needs: status page link, known-issue section, and a short workaround snippet for clients using streaming API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :eyes:

matt (Platform): saw it. I'll try to review today. Is this safe to merge during the 11:30-12:30 PST maintenance window?

elaine (Docs): Ideally before customers get the nightly report. We can wait for the preview CI, but that job is flaky during deploys. If CI fails only on the preview build, we should still consider merging with "docs-only" label and a quick post-merge check.

samir (SRE): FYI deploys are scheduled at 11:45. Preview CI is likely to be queued. If it's just mkdocs rendering errors we can bypass per our docs merge policy.

cara (Engineering): Are there code snippets that need to be sanitized? I can double-check the SDK examples.

elaine (Docs): Thanks — two tiny snippets. One fixes the status page link, the other adds this workaround for streaming reconnection:```python
# client reconnect helper
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        stream = client.start_stream(req)
        break
    except StreamResetError:
        time.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
else:
    raise
```

cara (Engineering): LGTM. I adjusted the import and replaced StreamResetError with the platform's StreamDisconnected in my suggestions.

matt (Platform): Quick note about the status page link: use the canonical status URL add UTM so analytics pick it up. Example: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-20?utm_source=docs

elaine (Docs): Good call. I added the UTM param. Also added an entry under "Known issues" describing a rare tokenization mismatch on quantized models and the temporary mitigation (downgrade to model v1.2 or pass use_legacy_tokenizer=true).

docs-ci-bot: [ci/docs-preview] Preview build started for PR #4822 — queued on runner-7

samir (SRE): If preview times out, I'm OK with a maintainers-override merge. We should leave a clear roll-forward plan in the PR description in case the docs render is broken on main.

elaine (Docs): Added a short roll-forward note and a manual post-merge render check step to the PR. Also pinging @cara for final thumbs.

cara (Engineering): Approving now. :thumbsup:

matt (Platform): Approving as well. If preview fails, please add the "maintainer-override" label and I'll do the merge.

docs-ci-bot: [ci/docs-preview] Build failed with non-deterministic render error in table-of-contents (exit code 2)

elaine (Docs): Ugh. That looks like the flaky mkdocs bug. I'll add the maintainer-override flag and proceed after a quick sanity check on the rendered HTML.

matt (Platform): Merged with maintainer-override at 1881122399. Post-merge render check: main/docs/status/index.html contains updated status link and Known issues section.

samir (SRE): Confirmed the public page shows the workaround snippet and the UTM on the status link. No regressions observed.

elaine (Docs): Thanks everyone. Will monitor for 1 hour and file a follow-up if customers report any trouble. :heart:
